title: clinopodium clivorum
intro: Clinopodium clivorum, commonly known as Kukui or Hawaiian candle nut, is a plant species in the mint family. It is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Clinopodium clivorum include its ability to act as an antiseptic, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it useful in treating wounds, skin conditions, and other health issues. The bioactive constituents of Clinopodium clivorum include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
